title: coding-area
description: German and english minecraft server community. Play challenges, manhunt, bingo and so much more!
body:
# Coding-Area

Since 2020, we have been an English- and German-speaking Minecraft community, best known for our open-source challenges plugin.

But there’s much more to our Minecraft network. It’s a place to chill out with friends, play creative minigames with plenty of challenges, and unlock a range of cosmetic items.

### Let me introduce you to a few of our favourite gamemodes:

**Challenges** for example:
Has playing through Minecraft become too easy or too boring for you? With a range of settings and restrictions, we’ll turn it into a whole new challenge.
Whether it’s with half a heart, no ability to regenerate, no ability to place blocks, just one inventory slot, or any of the other options available.
Set up a game like you’ve never played before

In **Manhunt**, you’re up against two things at once: Minecraft and your friends, who are out to hunt you down and kill you.

**Bingo** requires you to use all your knowledge of Minecraft and its items.

Visit [Coding-Area.net](https://coding-area.net/) and don't forget to join our [Discord](https://dc.coding-area.net/)
